description: This file defines the RabbitMQConsumerActor class, an Akka actor responsible for consuming messages from a RabbitMQ queue, processing the message, and forwarding it to a message mapping processor. It handles delivery processing, header extraction, message acknowledgment, and error handling within a messaging infrastructure.

classes.name: RabbitMQConsumerActor
classes.description: An Akka actor subclass responsible for consuming messages from RabbitMQ, processing headers and payloads, acknowledging messages, handling errors, and forwarding external messages to a processing actor.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns the Akka Props configuration for instantiating a RabbitMQConsumerActor with given parameters.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message processing behavior, handling message deliveries, resource status updates, and unknown messages.

methods.name: handleDelivery
methods.description: Processes an incoming RabbitMQ message delivery, extracts headers, constructs external messages, manages acknowledgments, and handles errors.

methods.name: shouldBeInterpretedAsBytes
methods.description: Determines if the message payload should be treated as raw bytes based on the content type.

methods.name: extractHeadersFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts and constructs a map of headers from the delivery properties and envelope, including standard headers like replyTo and correlationId.

methods.name: getHeadersFromProperties
methods.description: Converts a map of properties with Object values into a string-keyed map of headers.
